messages:
sasha: quick favor — can someone run a ramp + steady-state bench for gpt-6b-cb with cb_max_batch=48 and cb_max_tokens=1500? we've been seeing tail latency oscillation in canary on mixed seqs; need reproducible numbers for the RFC.

ken: on it. do you want the request mix to be short/long 70/30 (512/2048)? and what qps targets?

sasha: yep 70% short(512) / 30% long(2048). target sustained qps 900 for 10m, then ramp to 1300 for 5m, then back to 900. capture server queue depth, inflight, and kernel softirq stats. tag run `cb-osc-jul24`.

maria: i can schedule on perf infra. which pool — p4d-prod or p3x? p4d has different NIC/kernel tunables that might matter.

sasha: use p4d-prod (same as canary). run variant quant-8.

ken: starting now. loadgen command i'm using:
```
./loadgen --model gpt-6b-cb --variant quant8 \
  --mix 70:30 --seqs 512,2048 \
  --ramp 10m:900-1300 --steady 5m --tag cb-osc-jul24 \
  --cb_max_batch 48 --cb_max_tokens 1500 --out /tmp/cb-osc-jul24.json
```

ken: kicked off job from az-1/p4d-3. ETA ~25m. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/perf/cb-osc (will attach annotated panels)

ci-bot: Perf job scheduled: job/4821 started by ken. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4821/artifacts

maria: pinging infra to watch disk/network and kernel tunables; @ryan can you monitor node-level backpressure on the machine?

ryan: on it. watching az-1/p4d-3. will annotate if softirq/steal or OOM shows up.

ken: first pass numbers — p99 tail jumped during ramp: ~210ms -> ~820ms. queue depth spiked to ~1200 msgs at peak, inflight ~980. KV cache hit rates stayed ~99%. small log snippet: 
```
[2024-07-31T14:12:00Z] qdepth=1200 inflight=980 cb_batches=32 p99=820ms
[2024-07-31T14:12:30Z] qdepth=300 inflight=280 cb_batches=18 p99=230ms
```

maria: that matches the oscillation pattern we hypothesized. can you re-run with cb_max_batch=32 and cb_window_ms=40 to see if smaller batches stabilise tails?

ken: queued a re-run. also planning a run with cb_max_batch=64 cb_window_ms=10 so we can compare extremes.

sasha: don't change too many knobs at once — run the two variants separately and label them `cb-osc-32-40` and `cb-osc-64-10`. i'll take numbers and draft a short RFC recommending defaults if results are consistent.

ken: will post artifact links + a tiny markdown summary when all runs finish. opening a PR to capture perf artifacts: https://git.redwood/infer/perf-runs/pull/213

ryan: saw kernel softirq spikes correlated with qdepth peaks; forwarded capture to eng-infra for investigation.

ci-bot: Perf job completed: job/4821 -> PASSED. artifacts uploaded: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4821/artifacts/summary.json

maria: thanks — once ken posts full numbers i'll update the perf board and set a follow-up with infra if kernel-level mitigations look promising.

sasha: :thumbsup: huge help. if the 32/40 run cuts p99 by >2x under ramp, i'm comfortable proposing default cb_max_batch -> 32 for mixed workloads.

ken: thanks all — will post final summary here in ~45m with links to raw traces and grafana snapshots.

maria: noted, tagging oncall to watch for any perf regressions after default flips.

ken: final artifacts posted: https://ci.redwood/jobs/4830/artifacts (32-40) and https://ci.redwood/jobs/4831/artifacts (64-10). summary in PR #213.

sasha: closing loop — will draft RFC this week. cheers.
